patch_description: Replace the asymmetric CCRZ interaction with two symmetry-related ZZZ correlations on triads [2,4,6] and [1,3,8]. Sharing one angle across both triads preserves the current parameter count while regularizing the higher-order feature map. Removing the non-critical CZ [3,5] offsets the extra interaction gate and may reduce overfitting, which is currently indicated by the 0.09 generalization gap.
